props.name: aria-label
props.description: The textarea's name when no visible label names it. For a visible label, put it in a `Field.Root` with a `Field.Label` and pass it to `Field.Control`'s `render`, as in `<Field.Control render={<Textarea />} />`. A bare `Textarea` in a root is not wired to it.

props.name: size
props.description: The control size, also written as `data-size`. `default` is the md control size, and `sm` the sm one. The size sets the inline inset and the text size. At both sizes the box is at least 64px tall and grows with its text.
